sources.title: Parameter rays for the exponential family
sources.public_status: arXiv v1, submitted 6 May 2005; current downloaded PDF has 2018 internal date
sources.result: Simple roots and nonzero dynamic-ray potential derivative are explicit. Parameter C1 is stated; C-infinity is proposed, not proved in the inspected remark. Lemma 4.4 requires the extra tail threshold repaired by this audit.

sources.inspection: Corollary 3.5.2 and following remark, printed pages 97-98.
sources.result: Explicit continuously differentiable parameter-ray argument, followed by proposed C-infinity extension.

sources.title: The Differentiability of the Hairs of exp(Z)
sources.inspection: First two scanned pages visually inspected, including Theorems A/B. Complete PDF independently rehashed.
sources.result: Dynamic-plane C-infinity theorem, not a parameter-ray theorem.

sources.title: Classification of Escaping Exponential Maps
sources.inspection: Definitions of slow/fast addresses; Theorem 3.1, Corollary 3.2, Corollary 5.3 and Theorem 5.4 in the arXiv text.
sources.result: Endpoint/interior distinction and component classification; bounded addresses are slow. This supplies no endpoint differentiability.

sources.title: Non-analyticity of hairs of exponential maps
sources.public_status: arXiv 2609.32703v1; submitted September 26, 2026, PDF dated September 29, 2026; comments welcome. No journal publication asserted.
sources.inspection: Theorem 1 and fixed-map setup, plus dense attracting-basin input. Current arXiv metadata independently checked.
sources.result: Dynamic hairs of a fixed real map with 0<lambda<1/e; no parameter-hair consequence.
